props.title: GitHub issue templates shipped for aaronjmars/aeon

props.text: 1/ the 512-star, 170-fork aeon repo had zero issue templates until today. every bug report arrived in a different shape. PR #466 fixes that — three structured forms, aeon-native failure types.
2/ 170 forks. active external contributors. maintainers reading freeform issue dumps. no way to tell sandbox failure from API error from bad config — without a follow-up question every time.

3/ bug_report.yml asks for skill name, failure type (api/sandbox/config/output), run context (cron / dashboard / local), repro steps, logs. two gates: secrets redacted, existing issues searched. feature_request.yml adds a 'would you PR?' field.

4/ the agent is filing PRs on the repo it runs on. not user-facing features — contribution infrastructure. CONTRIBUTING.md last week. issue templates today. the question isn't 'who maintains the agent?' it's 'what does the agent maintain?'
